subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for highlighted group of words in the given sentence.

He devoted his entire life to the study of the human mind.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Psychology)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Psychology"** refers to the scientific study of the human mind and its functions, especially those affecting behavior in a given context. (मनोविज्ञान)

 
 
• **Example:** Psychology helps us understand why people behave the way they do and how mental processes influence actions.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, "He devoted his entire life to the study of the human mind," the term "Psychology" fits perfectly as a one-word substitute for "the study of the human mind." (मनोविज्ञान)
 
 
• **Example:** He pursued psychology to uncover the mysteries of human behavior and cognition.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Psychology)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Physics** (भौतिकी): The branch of science concerned with the nature and properties of matter and energy.

 
 
• **Example:** Physics explains how forces like gravity and magnetism work.
 
 
 
• **Philology** (भाषाशास्त्र): The study of language in written historical sources; it is a combination of literary studies, history, and linguistics.
 
 
• **Example:** Philology helps us decode ancient texts and understand their meanings.
 
 
 
• **Physiology** (शारीरिक विज्ञान): The branch of biology that deals with the normal functions of living organisms and their parts.
 
 
• **Example:** Physiology explains how the human body adapts to exercise and stress.
